svg.title: RL Lane-Keeping Simulator: Reinforcement Learning / Simulation
svg.desc: RL Lane-Keeping Simulator. PPO agents in a custom simulator, comparing camera, camera+LiDAR and full-stack sensing on collisions, lane deviation and completion.
